$comment: Coordinator operations of the people domain; the rules are in ops.schema.json $comment and contracts/README.md.

DispatchOrder.$comment: list: the section 6 order list; soonest_reset: ready candidates by earliest weekly reset among those with weekly left above 0 (fleet-people-access.md section 8)

FocusSetRequest.$comment: projectIds: a list of project ids in the caller's grants, or "*".

ListMembershipRequest.$comment: At most 1000 ids and one or two lists.

MeReply.$comment: email, name and grantsVersion are null without a person (agent-only stand).

MembershipAnswer.$comment: rows: the ids that are members of the list now.

sort.$comment: as the list's own page operation: task_page or sessions_list group and sort

items.$comment: One people.json entry (email, name, roles, owner, grants); never the service token's client ID.

PeopleSetReply.$comment: people: how many people the list now has.

PeopleSetRequest.$comment: Owner only: the whole people.json list, written atomically and reloaded.

listGroups.$comment: the list groups whose collapse differs from the page default, by <section>:<grouping> (e.g. tasks:project, delivery:stage; <section>:pinned holds the Pinned group); each value lists group keys, collapsed when the default is open and open when the default is collapsed

lastViews.$comment: the last view of each section by section id (its app path and query, e.g. /tasks?group=state); the navigation returns to it

navCollapsed.$comment: the navigation is collapsed to icons (OR-42); false when unset

pins.$comment: the person's pinned sidebar sections in their order (app shell); empty when unset

views.$comment: the person's saved list views (P5), in order; system presets live in the app and are not stored

focus.$comment: focused project ids (P6); '-' is no project; empty: every project. Lists and feeds without an explicit project filter use it

focusPresets.$comment: the person's saved focus selections, in order

ignored.$comment: project ids the person ignores (OR-34): hidden from their lists and counts wherever the focus applies, from the focus picker and from their search, even with every project in focus; a view that names a project itself still shows it; empty when unset

widths.$comment: column widths in px by column key (P13), e.g. nav, control

rowPins.$comment: pinned row ids by list name, e.g. tasks

list.$comment: the list the view belongs to, e.g. tasks

view.$comment: the view state (packages/view-url View: state, group, project, q, ...)

email.$comment: default: the caller; another person: the owner only

viewPut.$comment: save one view: replaces the view of that list with that name, or adds it at the end

viewDelete.$comment: remove one view by list and name; no error when absent

focusPresetPut.$comment: save one focus preset by name

focusPresetDelete.$comment: remove one focus preset by name

ignore.$comment: ignore (ignored true, added at the end; it also leaves the focus) or restore one project

ignored.$comment: omitted: unchanged; the full list replaces the previous one; a newly ignored project leaves the focus

rowPin.$comment: pin (pinned true, added at the end) or unpin one row of one list

email.$comment: default: the caller; another person: the owner only

pins.$comment: omitted: unchanged; the full ordered list replaces the previous one

views.$comment: omitted: unchanged; the full list replaces the previous one; names are unique per list

focusPresets.$comment: omitted: unchanged; the full list replaces the previous one

widths.$comment: omitted: unchanged; merged by key; a value of 0 removes the key (double-click reset)

listGroups.$comment: omitted: unchanged; merged by <section>:<grouping>; [] removes it; the whole group key list of that list replaces the stored one

lastViews.$comment: omitted: unchanged; merged by section id; an empty string removes it; each value is that section's app path (/<id>...)

rowPins.$comment: omitted: unchanged; merged by list name; [] clears that list

code.$comment: The current D17 code (T-FLT-42) of a task, question or conversation.

taskId.$comment: A question's task; the app opens it.

sessionId.$comment: A question's session; the app opens it when the question has no task.

agent.$comment: The harness: of the latest execution (task, conversation) or configured (agent).

outside.$comment: True when the hit is outside the request's projectIds focus; hosts, agents and pipelines never are.

at.$comment: The last change: a task updated, a conversation's latest activity, a question asked, a result stored, a definition revised.

Found.$comment: One found entity; the app opens /<kind>s/<id>, a question its task. state is the kind's own state (task, question, session or artifact states; none for projects, hosts, agents, pipelines).

counts.$comment: Per kind with a list section that takes the query (task, conversation, result): its matches in the focus (every project without one), the number that list shows for the same query. Only kinds with hits.

SearchReply.$comment: Hits of every provider in registry order: a query of only T-, Q- and C- codes resolved (old codes too, with the current code), then tasks (an id or code starting with the text first), questions (open first, answered and withdrawn after), conversations, results, projects, hosts, agents, pipelines. Inside each kind hits in the focus come before all others, then that kind's order, then recently changed. Each word of the text narrows the hits.

query.$comment: Free text plus field:value terms (agent, host, state, project), the list search syntax; a provider that cannot apply a term finds nothing.

projectIds.$comment: At most 1000. The caller's project focus (OR-34; '-' is work outside projects): hits in it come first and counts count only them. Absent or empty: every project.

ViewLinkReply.$comment: For view: url and path; for url: the parsed view.

ViewLinkRequest.$comment: Exactly one of view (a view state to link) or url (a Fleet URL to read back).
